title: leontodon radiatus
intro: Leontodon radiatus, commonly known as golden hawk's beard, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family. It is native to Europe and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Leontodon radiatus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as inhibiting cancer cell growth and reducing inflammation.
